title: The generated reports
lede: 8 reports, none of them hand-written. Each is produced by a command that reads the data and counts, so it cannot say something the data does not support and cannot go stale while the data moves. They are rendered here in full.

blocks.title: Why these are not summarised on this site
blocks.text: A summary is a second version with its own life. These are the originals: the dashboard renders them and restates nothing from them.

blocks.title: The ontology draft — what it holds and what it cannot answer
blocks.lede: Generated by `tmk-ontology-report`. Read section 5 if you read nothing else.

blocks.title: Stage 0 coverage — what the evaluation set still needs
blocks.lede: Generated by `tmk-coverage`. An hour of expert time should visibly move a number here.

blocks.title: The review queue, as the graph it is
blocks.lede: Generated by `tmk-blockers`. Which decision releases the most held records.

blocks.title: Corpus reconnaissance — where the material sits, across the Manual
blocks.lede: Generated by `tmk-recon` against the pinned snapshot. Every provision the Manual cites, costed, since you withdrew the section 43 boundary — including the 63% of passages that cite no provision at all and that no citation rule can reach.

blocks.title: RULE-0001 — every passage it flags, in full
blocks.lede: Generated by `tmk-flags`. What you asked to see on OQ-0003, and the count you were given was wrong: five passages, not 71.

blocks.title: Every concept the project holds, laid out for sorting
blocks.lede: Generated by `tmk-typing`. The evidence to sort by — what each concept is called, what it is explicitly not, the passages it came from, and whether the concept itself was signed by you or written by a machine.

blocks.title: Concept candidates from the whole Manual
blocks.lede: Generated by `tmk-concepts`. Terms the corpus defines and subjects the Manual files passages under, found deterministically across all 54 Parts. Candidates, not concepts — nothing here is authored and nothing is a judgement.

blocks.title: How the ideas join up — and which joins to distrust
blocks.lede: Generated by `tmk-relationships`. 219 edges found across all 54 Parts, the Act and the Regulations, joining concepts to each other and to the provisions that define them. Unlike the candidates above, **every one of these is a judgement a machine committed to and nobody has read** — section 4 lists the 25 weakest, lowest confidence first, which is where to start.
